proof_body:
by
  intro f c n hn hf ho
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg0, hfg⟩ := hf.analyticOrderAt_eq_natCast.mp ho
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (g c) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_pow hn] at ha
    exact hg0 ha.symm
  set q : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => g z / g c with hq
  have hqa : AnalyticAt ℂ q c := hg.div analyticAt_const hg0
  have hq1 : q c = 1 := div_self hg0
  have hslit : ∀ᶠ z in nhds c, q z ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    apply hqa.continuousAt.eventually_mem
    rw [hq1]
    exact Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.mem_nhds Complex.one_mem_slitPlane
  have hlog : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Complex.log (q z)) c := hqa.clog (by rw [hq1]; exact Complex.one_mem_slitPlane)
  set φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => a * Complex.exp (Complex.log (q z) / n) with hφ
  have hφa : AnalyticAt ℂ φ c := analyticAt_const.mul ((hlog.div analyticAt_const (by exact_mod_cast hn)).cexp)
  have hφc : φ c = a := by simp [hφ, hq1]
  have hn' : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hh : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => (z - c) * φ z) c := (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const).mul hφa
  refine ⟨fun z => (z - c) * φ z, hh, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => (z - c) * φ z) (1 * φ c + (c - c) * deriv φ c) c :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id c).sub_const c).mul hφa.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    rw [h1.deriv]
    simp [hφc, ha0]
  · filter_upwards [hfg, hslit] with z hz hs
    rw [hz, mul_pow, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    simp only [hφ, mul_pow]
    rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hn', Complex.exp_log (Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hs), ha]
    simp only [hq]
    field_simp
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (n : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ f c → analyticOrderAt f c = n → ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ h c ∧ h c = 0 ∧ deriv h c ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᶠ z in nhds c, f z = h z ^ n
